title: screenshot arguments
description: Capture one display, or a region of it, and mint a frame.

holder_id.description: The frame is scoped to this holder. Holding the lease is not required to take a screenshot.

display_id.description: The display to capture. Defaults to the main display.

region.description: Region to capture, in global points. Must lie entirely inside the display's bounds. Defaults to the whole display.

max_long_edge.description: Upper bound on the longer output edge, in pixels.
